snapshot.text: Social health insurance system with chronic underfunding and an exodus of doctors abroad. The health minister is pushing financing reform: money following the patient, performance-based pay and a bigger role for outpatient care and prevention.

priorities.title: Hospital financing follows the patient
priorities.text: Hospital funding is to follow patients rather than beds, with performance-based payments for staff.

priorities.title: Outpatient care and prevention
priorities.text: Specialist outpatient clinics get longer hours, more funding and a central role in prevention.

priorities.title: Health insurance reform
priorities.text: The minister has pushed for a privately managed public insurance system.
